title: Worker isolation Half B: route worker spawn through the dev container
description:
Follow-up to CAM-111 (Half A shipped in PR #110, v0.37.0), which added the additive isolation artifact: .devcontainer/{Dockerfile,devcontainer.json,init-firewall.sh} (non-root worker, pinned claude-code@2.1.197, egress default-deny with exactly 7 allowlisted domains) plus an exported-but-uncalled preflightWorkerContainer() helper and ADR 0003 + recovery-runbook section (x). Half B is the behavior-changing integration half Half A deliberately deferred.

Scope: (1) rewrite the worker spawn in src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts and host.ts to launch the implementer+reviewer worker INSIDE the container (devcontainer up/exec or docker run) attached to the tmux pane PTY, preserving spawn invariants: env -u CLAUDECODE (CAM-43), lowercase --session-id (CAM-23), atomic send-keys text+Enter (CAM-55). (2) Wire preflightWorkerContainer() into the dispatch path so a missing Docker daemon or unbuilt image is caught before dispatch. (3) FAIL-CLOSED: if the container does not start, the worker MUST NOT fall back to running un-contained on the host; the loop emits a clear error and halts/escalates (a silent host fallback defeats the gate). (4) Credentials: git push via a repo-scoped/short-lived GITHUB_TOKEN through containerEnv (never ~/.ssh or a host cred file); claude auth via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (claude setup-token) or the named ~/.claude volume; document the credential handling. (5) Live validation (issue acceptance criterion 10, requires:operator): a real/representative story completes GREEN inside the container (bun test + tsc + git push pass under the firewall), captured as evidence (ties into CAM-116). (6) Docs: extend the recovery-runbook container section with fail-closed behavior and container-failure recovery.

Gotchas: the whole-process firewall now governs the implementer Step-5.5 WebFetch doc-validation too (keep heavy doc reads at plan-time in the orchestrator, outside the container; worker WebFetch is best-effort within the allowlist, do not silently lose doc validation); Docker Desktop on macOS runs a Linux VM so the worker runs Linux while tmux stays on the host pane (attach by PTY); the reference init-firewall.sh resolves domains to IPs once at container start, so CDN-backed hosts (raw.githubusercontent.com, *.github.com) rotate IPs and can later-drop, needs periodic re-resolve or DNS-based matching (reviewer SUGGESTION, CAM-111 round 1); objects.github.com is not a real LFS host (LFS objects live at objects.githubusercontent.com), fix the *.github.com subdomain list if git LFS is needed.

After this ships it WIRES the spawn, so rebuild+reinstall+restart the sidecar to encarnate the new spawn behavior before relying on it (Half A needed no rebuild because it was inert). Depends on CAM-111 (shipped). Priority: safety net for full-autonomy (plan_approval=auto is live); per CAM-111 escalation rule (Fase 1 rises to P1 when plan_approval=auto is on) and because Half B is the actual enforcement, it is P1, above the plan/ship-runner epics.
